title: Dream Proposals v1
description: Advisory divergent architectural hypotheses (tier 3). Speculative invention grounded in cited tension-bearing evidence; never a deterministic change.

mode.description: carrier_swap = same capability, different realization carrier. function_remap = redraw the capability/function binding. Both must carry an explicit current -> proposed structural delta.

idea.description: The divergent architectural hypothesis as 'move/split/invert X from current structure to proposed structure'.

targetCapabilityIds.description: Each MUST equal a capabilities[].id in the capability map.

anchorId.description: MUST resolve to a real id of the named kind in the source model / capability map / computed graph-structural anchor set.

claim.description: The current-state tension this anchor is asserted to support.

provenanceClass.description: Set by the gate for resolved evidence. Label only; not an acceptance gate.

currentStructure.description: The current structure being reshaped. carrier_swap requires fromCarrier; function_remap requires fromBinding.

proposedStructure.description: The different proposed structure. carrier_swap requires toCarrier; function_remap requires toBinding.

rationale.description: Why the cited tension supports this exact structural mutation, not just any local fix.

premiseConfidence.description: MECHANICAL. Set by the gate: all_resolved iff every citedEvidence anchor resolves and the dream is admissible. dream_emit renders only all_resolved.

band.description: SOFT and CAPPED. 'high' is forbidden pre-emission: benefit is structurally unverifiable before the repo agent tries it.

action.description: What the repo agent should TRY, e.g. 'move auth/session handling behind a ClientPort seam while preserving public tools'.

observable.description: Named computable axis/metric or buildable fitness function, e.g. 'fan-in count for node X', 'import-cycle count', 'test-seam count'.

neighborAlternativeId.description: For carrier_swap: the snapshot.near_neighbor_alternatives[].id this swap corresponds to, if any. Raises rank (cheaper to validate).
